claims.statement: DEP01-A averaged 515.11 across 12 measured wafers with 12 out of control and 7 out of spec, versus 502.76 on DEP01-B, 499.54 on DEP02-A and 501.52 on DEP02-B, with 2734 wafers since PM and no PM in 72h
DEP01-A thickness rose from 513.95 in the first half to 516.28 in the second half with slope 0.757 per 100 wafers ending at 518.69
Commonality DEP p-value is 0.0 with DEP01-A at 516.28 versus 503.18 and 499.9 and 500.76, while CLEAN p-value is 0.8594 with 507.03 versus 506.31
DEP01-A reads high on both MET01 at 515.94 and 516.13 and 516.2 and 518.69 and MET02 at 515.33 and 515.38, from both clean tools
FDC z-scores are -0.4 and -0.7 and -0.1 and 0.1 with recent means 399.95 and 300.05 and 2.0006 and 99.95 showing no sensor shift

disposition.summary: DEP01-A is drifting high from buildup with 2734 wafers since PM, reading high on both metrology tools and both clean routes. FDC sensors are normal and commonality isolates the DEP step. Lot must be held and chamber held for PM.

notes.text: Investigating alarm on LOT-1239 — pulling the alarm details.
Alarm is out-of-spec at 518.69 — checking the lot history to trace its path.
Evidence points to DEP01-A specifically — checking sensors to confirm a real chamber drift.

truth.explanation: DEP01-A is overdue for PM; buildup has pushed deposition up, thickest at the edge.

public: US Patent 6,512,991, Reducing deposition variation by modeling post-clean chamber performance
Material builds up on the chamber's inner surfaces with use and changes the deposition rate.
sources.practitioner: Deposition shows buildup more clearly than etch: material collects inside the chamber and the rate usually rises with it. Fabs compensate by wafer count since PM, which hides most but not all of the drift.
